# `/connector-customizers` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /connector-customizers/v1

`listConnectorCustomizersV1` — List all connector customizers

List all connector customizers.

- Scopes: sp:connector:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
- Returns 200: array of connectorcustomizersresponse

### POST /connector-customizers/v1

`createConnectorCustomizerV1` — Create connector customizer

Create a connector customizer.

- Scopes: sp:connector:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): connectorcustomizercreaterequest
- Returns 201: connectorcustomizercreateresponse

### GET /connector-customizers/v1/{id}

`getConnectorCustomizerV1` — Get connector customizer

Gets connector customizer by ID.

- Scopes: sp:connector:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the connector customizer to get.
- Returns 200: connectorcustomizersresponse

### PUT /connector-customizers/v1/{id}

`putConnectorCustomizerV1` — Update connector customizer

Update an existing connector customizer with the one provided in the request body. These fields are immutable: `id`, `name`, `type`.

- Scopes: sp:connector:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the connector customizer to update.
- Body (application/json): connectorcustomizerupdaterequest
- Returns 200: connectorcustomizerupdateresponse

### DELETE /connector-customizers/v1/{id}

`deleteConnectorCustomizerV1` — Delete connector customizer

Delete the connector customizer for the given ID.

- Scopes: sp:connector:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the connector customizer to delete.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /connector-customizers/v1/{id}/versions

`createConnectorCustomizerVersionV1` — Creates a connector customizer version

Creates a new version for the customizer.

- Scopes: sp:connector:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The id of the connector customizer.
- Returns 200: connectorcustomizerversioncreateresponse
